Author: Michiru Tsukikage
Name: Crucible SUX
Description:
Crucible SUX (Set-and-forget Unbroken eXecutor) tracks your Beastmaster's Crucible of the Unbroken progress: boards, degrees, Apex and Legendary scores, beasts befriended and their ranks.
It checks whether you can clear the remaining boards in one sitting and suggests a team per board.
Its session queue runs boards through AutoDuty (erdelf's build), watches every run, stops a stuck one and reports back. Its opt-in journey does the Beastmaster job quests, collects the beasts and levels the job to 50, each part off by default. Unattended automation is against the game's terms of service: use it at your own risk.
Punchline: Set-and-forget Unbroken eXecutor: queue the Crucible of the Unbroken boards, step away, come back to a report.
Changelog:
Fixed

- **Standing still while being hit:** when mobs attacked first (a Bog Yarzon and a Stagnant Water Sprite in the play-test), levelling left the fight to Rotation Solver Reborn. RSR neither moves the character nor starts its auto-attack, so the character stood there losing HP until the flee kicked in.
  - A fight already under way now goes through the full fight-back: flee when it is not worth taking, else target the attacker, walk to it and turn auto-attack on, with the rotation adding its skills.
  - Auto-attack is turned on with the hotbar toggle only while it is off, read the way BossMod reads it, so it is never switched off by mistake. This applies when fighting back, to mobs fought while levelling, to captures and to the dummy steps.
